name: Bladud

attributes.attribute: founded Bath according to Geoffrey of Monmouth
lit an unquenchable fire for the goddess Sul
may be the genius loci of the place

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Bladud is a British hero or god. The writer Geoffrey of Monmouth said that Bladud founded the great spa at Bath. Bladud lit an unquenchable fire there for the goddess Sul. Some argue that Bladud was never a real king but the spirit of the place, what the Celts call a genius loci.

okr.objective: Outline a British hero or god who founded Bath and lit a fire for the goddess Sul.
key_results: Bladud is a British hero or god.
